ITEM 1 | Mixed loose salad greens in a heap covering roughly 35-40% of the plate's central area, mostly bright and mid green leaves with ruffled, frilly edges and some smooth broader leaves, slightly moist with no visible dressing sheen, piled about 4-5 cm high in the center-right of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Dark reddish-purple, glossy, soft pieces interspersed among the greens, roughly 8-10 cm across in total, some small irregular chunks and slices with a slightly wet, juicy surface, no visible browning or char, sitting directly under and between the leaves | 35
